name: MMBench-CN
intro: MMBench-CN 是 MMBench 的中文子集/分项，报告中用于观察多模态模型中文视觉问答表现。
org: Shanghai AI Laboratory, Nanyang Technological University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
build_method: 三级能力体系, 志愿者多源收集, 双路质量过滤, GPT-4翻译与人工核验
eval_feature: 中文视觉问答, CircularEval, 选项抽取
scale: 3,217道题, 20个细粒度能力, 开发/测试=4:6
build_method_en: Three-level ability taxonomy, volunteer multi-source collection, dual quality filtering, GPT-4 translation and human verification
eval_feature_en: Chinese Visual QA, CircularEval, Choice extraction
intro_en: MMBench-CN is the Chinese subset or breakdown of MMBench used in reports to inspect multimodal Chinese visual-QA performance.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2307.06281 Sections 3-5. MMBench defines a three-level perception/reasoning taxonomy with 20 leaf abilities, seeds 10-20 MCQs per ability, and has student volunteers expand them from Internet and public-validation sources. Text-only majority success and all-VLM failure each trigger manual quality review. The curated 3,217 English items are translated by GPT-4 except proper nouns, symbols, and code, then human-verified for MMBench-CN and split dev/test 4:6. Evaluation uses image-grounded 2-4 choice questions, heuristic then GPT-4-0125 choice extraction, and CircularEval, which requires all N rotated-choice passes correct before reporting accuracy.
